title: 第580章 长宁天子玄岳蟠龙台第579章 花莫妖染了脏东西
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡人修仙，捡个仙子做老婆第一卷：默认第580章长宁天子，玄岳蟠龙台（..la）周元静静的看了会儿花莫妖，最后还是无奈的摇了摇头。
这妖精太聪明了。
自己这是送上门来了，花莫妖岂能轻易饶了他。
“说吧，怎么才肯帮我这个忙？”
“周师兄的妹妹，也是我的妹妹。”
花莫妖没有提条件，如花娇颜，笑语盈盈：“这个忙，我帮了。”
“就这么简单？”
“我跟你之间，从来都不复杂的。”
“那我等你消息了。”
周元心里明白。
没条件，才是最可怕的条件。
这一次，花莫妖无条件的帮了忙。
以后花莫妖需要帮忙，他还能拒绝吗？
但是没办法，救项符瑶要紧了。
“周师兄……”
花莫妖看周元跳下去后，突然又喊住了他，轻柔笑语：“往南百里，那里要热闹了。我过不去了，你能替我照顾下凌玉仪吗？”
百里外。
大地沉陷，裂缝纵横，方圆数十里不见草木。
一座残破的石殿，被废墟巨石掩埋，难辨轮廓，只见殿门恢宏，古纹纵横。
石殿埋葬了无尽岁月，古纹依然绽放着淡淡灵光，透发出一股沉厚之气，压盖整座废墟。

此时此刻，殿前已经聚集了很多人。
王家的黑鳞龙蟒翻涌奔腾，扫开殿前碎石，浑身磷光闪耀，悍然撞上了高约十丈的殿门。
“隆隆……”
殿门巍然如岳，虽然剧烈晃动，却是纹丝不动。
轰隆！！
天雷暴动，震耳欲聋，毁灭雷霆怒卷而起，吞没整座殿门。
萧家九重天的萧震廷，展现实力，朝着那殿门打出了萧家传承之法——寂灭印。
然而……
那狂暴的天雷甚至都没在殿门表面，留下丝毫的痕迹。
古纹微弱的闪烁，如摇摇欲熄的烛光，却没有分毫减弱。
“给我……破！！”
焚月宗的弟子，当众演化出九道火轮，烈烈焚烧，内蕴提天火之威，紧随着那暴动的天雷，暴击巍峨如岳的巨型殿门。
然而……
依旧不见任何效果。
“吼……”
正当云集前面的其他人，要继续联手发力的时候。一道咆哮，如石破天惊般，在这废墟之地炸响。
无论是远远围观的，还是前面进攻的，都在这咆哮之中抱头惨叫，只觉灵魂都要被撕裂了。
“吼……”
龙墟岛的天兽金犼，出现在了这片废墟，它浑身如黄金铸造，金鳞灿灿，满目凶光。直接无视了前面云集的那些强者，尖锐的利爪踏动地面，卷起股金色狂风，狠狠撞上了那座殿门。
轰！

殿门剧烈摇晃，掩埋的巨石都隆隆颤动，碎石粉尘簌簌如瀑。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: A mortal cultivates immortality and picks up a fairy to be his wife. Volume 1: Default Chapter 580: Emperor Changning, Xuanyue Panlongtai (..la) Zhou Yuan looked at Hua Mo Yao quietly for a while, and finally shook his head helplessly.
This goblin is so smart.
He was sent to his door, how could Hua Moyao let him go so easily.
"Tell me, why are you willing to do this for me?"
"Senior Brother Zhou's sister is also my sister."
Hua Moyao didn't put any conditions. She was as charming as a flower and smiled brightly: "I'll help you with this."
"Is it that simple?"
"It's never been complicated between you and me."
"Then I'll wait for your news."
Zhou Yuan understood in his heart.
No conditions are the most terrifying conditions.
This time, Hua Moyao helped unconditionally.
If Hua Mo Yao needs help in the future, can he still refuse?
But there is no way, it is urgent to save Xiang Fuyao.
"Senior Brother Zhou..."
After Hua Moyao saw Zhou Yuan jump down, he suddenly stopped him and said with a soft smile: "Go a hundred miles to the south, it's going to be lively there. I can't get through, can you take care of Ling Yuyi for me?"
Hundreds of miles away.
The earth has sunk, cracks are criss-crossing, and there is no vegetation for dozens of miles.
A dilapidated stone palace was buried under ruins and boulders, and its outline was difficult to discern. All that could be seen was the majestic gate of the palace, with ancient patterns crisscrossing it.
The stone palace has been buried for endless years, and the ancient patterns still shine with a faint aura, exuding a heavy aura that covers the entire ruins.
At this moment, many people had gathered in front of the temple.
The Wang family's black-scaled dragon python surged and galloped, sweeping away the rubble in front of the palace, its body shining with phosphorescent light, and slammed into the palace door, which was about ten feet high.
"Rumble..."
The palace gate is as majestic as a mountain. Although it shakes violently, it does not move at all.
Boom! !
The sky thunder exploded, deafening, and the destructive thunder rolled up and swallowed up the entire palace door.
Xiao Zhenting, who was in the ninth level of the Xiao family, showed his strength and hit the Xiao family's inherited method - the Seal of Annihilation - towards the palace door.
However...
The violent thunder did not even leave the slightest trace on the surface of the palace door.
The ancient pattern flickered faintly, like a flickering candlelight, but it did not weaken at all.
"Give me...break!!"
The disciples of the Burning Moon Sect evolved nine fire wheels in public, burned fiercely, and contained the power of heavenly fire. They followed the rioting thunder and struck the huge palace gate as tall as a mountain.
However...
Still no effect.
"Roar..."
Just when the others gathered in front were about to continue to join forces to exert their efforts. A roar, like an earth-shattering roar, exploded in the ruins.
Whether they were watching from a distance or attacking from the front, they all held their heads and screamed in the roar, feeling that their souls were about to be torn apart.
"Roar..."
The celestial beast of Longxu Island, Jin Hu, appeared in the ruins. Its body was made of gold, its golden scales were brilliant, and its eyes were filled with fierce light. Ignoring the strong men gathered in front of him, he stepped on the ground with his sharp claws, whipped up a golden gust of wind, and slammed into the palace door.
boom!
The door of the palace shook violently, the huge rocks buried there rumbled and trembled, and the gravel and dust rustled like a waterfall.
